content.title: About
content.content: Pumpkin bread is a loaf in which pumpkin puree or grated pumpkin is incorporated into the dough. It has a soft, slightly moist crumb, a subtle pumpkin aroma, and a gentle sweetness typical of autumn baked goods.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pumpkin is rich in beta‑carotene, which turns into vitamin A during cooking.
Pumpkin bread is especially popular in the United States around Halloween and Thanksgiving.
Pumpkin adds very little fat, making the bread less calorie‑dense than many sweet breads.
Pumpkin puree helps retain moisture in the dough, keeping the loaf tender and fresh longer.

items.title: High in beta‑carotene
items.content: Beta‑carotene converts to vitamin A, supporting vision and immune function.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Pumpkin provides fiber that aids normal digestion.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Pumpkin bread typically contains less saturated fat than traditional sweet breads.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Potassium in pumpkin helps regulate blood pressure.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Vitamins C and E in pumpkin protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Pumpkin allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to pumpkin.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Pumpkin bread is often sweetened, so individuals with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Traditional bread contains gluten, making it unsuitable for those with celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pumpkin bread can be enjoyed as a snack on its own, spread with butter, cheese, or nut butters, used for sandwiches, or served alongside soups and salads. Warm slices are especially aromatic.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store pumpkin bread in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze in freezer‑safe bags for up to 2 months. Thaw and warm in the oven before serving.
